Description: Encapsulates one bus transaction PLUS the event-pulse vector. Fields include addr (CTRL/EVT_SEL/COUNT/THRESH/STATUS), we, data, wstrb, rdata, event_in[7:0], and irq_out observation.
Key_Methods: new(); convert2string(); do_copy(); do_compare(); do_print(); randomize()
Signals_Used: addr[7:0], data[31:0], we, wstrb[3:0], rdata[31:0], event_in[7:0], irq_out

Description: Drives bus transactions to Event Counter and also drives event_in[7:0] pulse lines according to the sequence item. Handles single-cycle event pulse generation with configurable gap between pulses.
Key_Methods: build_phase(); run_phase(); drive_transaction(); drive_event_pulse(bit[7:0] mask, int count)
Signals_Used: clk, rst_n, bus_req, bus_we, bus_addr, bus_wdata, bus_wstrb, bus_ready, bus_rdata, bus_err, event_in[7:0]

Description: Monitors bus transactions AND samples event_in pulses and irq_o. Writes captured transactions (with event context) to analysis port for scoreboard.
Signals_Used: clk, bus_req, bus_ready, bus_we, bus_addr, bus_rdata, event_in[7:0], irq_o

Description: Standard UVM sequencer parameterised on event_cnt_seq_item.
Container for event counter VIP components. Conditionally instantiates driver/sequencer based on is_active.
Reference model tracking: active EVT_SEL, expected count per event, threshold comparison, overflow detection, W1C behaviour, and IRQ_EN gating.
Key_Methods: write(); check_count(); check_thresh(); check_ovf(); check_w1c(); check_irq(); check_phase()

Description: Covergroups for: evt_sel[2:0] (all 8), addr (all 5 registers), ctrl_bits (EN/CLEAR/IRQ_EN), status_flags (OVF/THRESH_HIT), cross(evt_sel, addr).
Provides shared tasks: do_write(addr,data), do_read(addr), drive_event(sel, count, gap_clks).
Sets EVT_SEL=0, clears, enables, drives N load pulses on events_in[0], reads COUNT and verifies.
Sets EVT_SEL=1, drives N store pulses on events_in[1], verifies COUNT.
Sets EVT_SEL=2 (Fetch), drives pulses on events_in[2], verifies COUNT.
Sets EVT_SEL=3 (Branch/Jump), drives pulses on events_in[3], verifies COUNT.
Sets EVT_SEL=4 (Stall), drives pulses on events_in[4], verifies COUNT.
Sets EVT_SEL=5 (Exception), drives pulses on events_in[5], verifies COUNT.
Sets EVT_SEL=6 (Timer Tick), drives pulses on events_in[6], verifies COUNT.
Sets EVT_SEL=7 (UART TX Done), drives pulses on events_in[7], verifies COUNT.
Writes THRESH=5, drives 6 events, reads STATUS to confirm THRESH_HIT=1.
Backdoor preset COUNT near 32'hFFFF_FFFF, drives 3 pulses, reads STATUS to confirm OVF=1.
Triggers THRESH_HIT, then writes STATUS=0x02 (W1C) and verifies THRESH_HIT clears to 0.
Writes CTRL with IRQ_EN=1, triggers overflow, verifies irq_o asserts. Then disables IRQ_EN, re-triggers, verifies irq_o stays 0.
